title: Mobile Mechanic Warranty Request Form
subtitle: Control mobile diagnosis, vehicle stabilization, repair, testing, and return or tow decision through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete mobile mechanic service warranty request for vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls. It connects approved repair scope, service information, and site plan to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a mobile-service dispatcher must investigate a mobile mechanic service warranty or callback without treating the request as a coverage decision before identity, chronology, condition, and evidence are reviewed.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic interim control and preservation
sections.guidance: Protect people, property, evidence, and the claimed item while preserving the distinction between temporary help and a final remedy.

blocks.label: Interim control and preservation options
items: Vehicle authority, dispatch location, VIN, unit, and requested scope confirmed
Traffic, visibility, weather, terrain, lighting, and escape path assessed
Vehicle parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, and protected from impact
Jack, stands, lift points, cribbing, and ground capacity verified before elevation
Ignition, keys, battery, high voltage, stored pressure, heat, and moving parts controlled
Fuel, oil, coolant, refrigerant, battery, and spill or fire controls available
Service information, torque values, parts, tools, and recall status checked
Customer and bystanders kept outside the controlled work zone
Removed parts, fluids, batteries, tires, and contaminated material controlled
Functional test, leak check, roadworthiness decision, and tow route defined

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic warranty exception and escalation
sections.guidance: Route unsafe, disputed, missing-evidence, third-party, or out-of-scope conditions without implying a coverage outcome.

blocks.label: Mobile Mechanic exception and stop-work indicators
items: Traffic, shoulder, grade, weather, lighting, or escape path is unsafe
Vehicle cannot be parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, or protected
Jack, stand, lift point, cribbing, or ground capacity is uncertain
Unexpected start, movement, pressure, heat, electrical, or high-voltage energy
Fuel, vapor, battery, fire, hot-surface, fluid, refrigerant, or spill concern
Tire, spring, air system, hydraulic system, or other stored energy uncontrolled
Service information, recall status, torque, calibration, or part compatibility uncertain
Repair exceeds mobile capability, available tools, environment, or authorization
Roadworthiness, braking, steering, tire, wheel, lighting, or structural condition uncertain
Customer requests driving or operation before required testing or tow decision
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Exception containment, decision, and escalation register

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic warranty request closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This mobile mechanic service warranty request is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when traffic, vehicle support, lifting, stored energy, high voltage, fuel, fire, weather, spill, repair information, or roadworthiness condition is uncertain. A automotive or fleet safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
